text: I ended up here by accident when my insurance company refused to cover my tooth. The ladies provided excellent care and put me at ease. I had four sessions (I visited the office five times in total) of root canal treatment and several X-rays (they have a machine on site). The tooth was preserved for the flight back to Poland. Back home, my dentist said, "Good job! It's clear someone who knows what they're doing did it." I highly recommend them and send my regards to both ladies!
